tray.welcome.title: AudioRemote is running in the notification area
tray.welcome.body: Closing this window does not stop it. Its icon sits next to the clock, and opens the app at any time. If you cannot see it, click the "∧" left of the clock to show hidden icons.
tray.welcome.setupNote: Starts AudioRemote at sign-in, allows connections from your LAN (Windows asks for permission once), and copies the share URL.
tray.welcome.setupNotePackaged: Copies the share URL. Start at sign-in is already on in the Store edition, so nothing here is changed.
tray.welcome.openNote: Opens this host's page in your default browser.
tray.alreadyRunning.title: AudioRemote is already running
tray.alreadyRunning.body:
Its icon is in the notification area, to the left of the clock. If you cannot see it, click the "^" button to show hidden icons.

A second copy cannot use the listening port, so it can do nothing. Closing this window ends it; the first one keeps running.
tray.setup.doneBody:
Start at logon is on and LAN access is allowed. The share URL is on your clipboard — paste it into the browser on your other machine.

Close this window and an arrow will point at AudioRemote's icon. That icon is how you open it from now on.
tray.setup.noFirewallBody:
Start at logon is on and the share URL is on your clipboard. LAN access was not allowed, so other machines may not reach this host yet.

Close this window and an arrow will point at AudioRemote's icon. That icon is how you open it from now on.
tray.setup.noShareBody:
Start at logon is on. There is no share URL to copy yet — LAN access is off, or there is no usable token.

Close this window and an arrow will point at AudioRemote's icon. That icon is how you open it from now on.
tray.setup.failedBody:
Setup did not finish. Run `audioremote --install-autostart` from a terminal.

AudioRemote itself is running. Close this window and an arrow will point at its icon.
tray.setup.packagedBody:
The share URL is on your clipboard — paste it into the browser on your other machine.

Start at sign-in and LAN access are both on already in the Store edition (start at sign-in can be switched off in Task Manager → Startup apps).

Close this window and an arrow will point at AudioRemote's icon. That icon is how you open it from now on.
tray.setup.packagedNoShareBody:
There is no share URL to copy yet — LAN access is off, or there is no usable token.

Start at sign-in and LAN access are both on already in the Store edition.

Close this window and an arrow will point at AudioRemote's icon. That icon is how you open it from now on.
